notes: Chunk 109 has six pages, each with a single Common Crawl capture from CC-MAIN-2021-39 (no live copy was supplied); all six were readable, none unreadable. sourceUrl is the Common Crawl index lookup address from each file's footer; sourceDate is the date in the file name. (1) University of Houston, Bauer, Ph.D. Program in Management "Recent Placements" (2021-09-21; page footer says last modified 29 September 2020): 28 Management & Leadership alumni written "Name (YYYY) - Institution" under "Our Ph.D. alumni accepted academic positions at:". The year in parentheses is not labelled; it is recorded as yearMeaning "placement" because the page is a placements list (the convention used for year columns on placement pages in earlier proposals), but it could equally be the degree year, so an integrator should treat it as placement-or-graduation. No titles are printed. Management department list; no operations graduates. (2) University of Kentucky, Gatton, Management track "Initial Placements" (2021-09-20): 16 rows of a table whose first column is explicitly "Graduation Year", so yearMeaning is "graduation"; Place of Employment and Title copied as printed (Zackary Edens 2015 is "Adjunct" at University of Kentucky; Tejas Channagiri Ajit 2018 is a "Post-Doctoral Scholar" at University of Florida at Gainesville). "Georgia State & Technical College" and "North Dakota State" are copied as printed. Management list; no operations graduates. (3) University of Utah, Eccles, Ph.D. "Job Market Candidates" (2021-09-24; page dated 2021-08-19 so this is the 2021-22 market): 16 candidates across seven tracks with no year and no destination; listedYear null, yearMeaning "job-market"; dissertation topics kept in note. Three (Huayi Tang, Finance; Joseph Dunbar, Information Systems; Syd Alavi, Operations) have only a bio link and no dissertation topic. Syd Alavi is the one Operations candidate. (4) University of Utah, Eccles, Ph.D. "Job Placements" (2021-09-24; page dated 2021-08-19): 92 graduates grouped by track and year heading, each with a "Placement:" line and a "Dissertation:" line; yearMeaning "placement" (year headings on a placements page, not labelled). Three people have no Placement line (Anuj Kapoor 2019 Marketing, Michelle Chambers 2021 Organizational Behavior, Chad Killebrew 2019 Strategy): destination null. One Marketing 2020 entry is printed with the single name "Ramakrishnan"; copied as printed. Placement strings are copied whole into destination; where the string carries a title in parentheses or as a prefix it is also copied into position ("Visiting Prof", "Visiting Professor", "Post Doc", "Post-Doc", "Visiting"), e.g. "Southern Methodist University (Visiting Prof)", "Texas Tech (Visiting Professor)", "UCSD (Visiting Professor)", "Post Doc at Vanderbilt University", "University of Notre Dame (Post Doc)", "Visiting at Oklahoma City University", "Harvard University (Post-Doc)". The Operations section is the operations-relevant part: Sina Moghadas Khorasani 2019 (UC San Diego), Ming Jin 2016 (University of Oregon), Chunlin Wang 2016 (Post Doc at Vanderbilt University), Francois Giraud-Carrier 2014 (University of Illinois at Springfield), Scott Lindsey 2012 (Dixie State College).
